svg.text: STAGE 523 · TOPIC 163 · P1039–P1040 🎉 · SVG 167 · 165th FAQ 🎉 · 🎉 HISTORIC 90th ROUND, P1040, 165th FAQ & 965-TEST MILESTONE!
SIP RFC 3323 / RFC 3325 Privacy critical 500 Fail-Closed & 6-Field Deep Anonymization Guard
⛔ Vulnerable RFC 3323 Path (Cleartext Breach & Partial Scrub)
1. Ignored Privacy: ...;critical Forwarding Cleartext Calls
Privacy: user;session;critical (RTP relay down -> Sent anyway!)
• Violates RFC 3323 §5 mandate to fail closed with 500 Server Error
• Exposes whistleblower / VIP caller identity when relay is offline
2. Half-Baked From-Only Rewrite Leaking 5 Other Fields
From=anonymous, but Contact: <sip:alice@10.24.1.9> & SDP o=alice
• Call-ID: 99@alice-macbook.corp and Via leak internal hostname/IP
• SDP o= username and IP expose exact endpoint despite From mask
3. Unstripped Egress Privacy Header Metadata Leak
Egress INVITE still carries Privacy: user;header;session
• Signals to untrusted external peers that call was scrubbed
• Violates RFC 3323 §5 Privacy Service header removal rules
✅ Deterministic RFC 3323 Guardrails (P1039 + P1040 🎉)
P1039 (1,048th Guardrail): Fail-Closed 500 on Unfulfilled critical
action: "reject_unfulfilled_critical_privacy_with_500_and_cap_tokens"
• Rejects call locally with 500 if any critical token is unfulfilled
• clampedCleartextForwardsDespiteCriticalPrivacy = 0
• clampedPrivacyTokensPerHeaderCount in [1, 6] tokens
Policy: P1039-SIP-RFC3323-PRIVACY-CRITICAL-ENFORCEMENT-AND-UNSUPPORTED-TOKEN-500-GUARD
P1040 🎉 (90th Round, P1040, 165th FAQ & 965 Tests!): 6-Field Scrub
action: "scrub_from_via_contact_callid_sdp_origin_and_strip_privacy_header"
• Scrubs From, Contact, Via, Call-ID@host, User-Agent & SDP o=/c=
• clampedLeakedViaContactCallIdOrSdpOriginFields = 0
• Strips fulfilled egress Privacy headers (unstrippedHeaders = 0)
Policy: P1040-SIP-RFC3323-HEADER-USER-SESSION-FULL-ANONYMIZATION-AND-SDP-ORIGIN-SCRUB-GUARD
PROVENANCE, TIMING DISCLOSURE & STAGE 523 BENCHMARK SCORECARD (526 DIMENSIONS · 1,049 GUARDRAILS · 1,058 PROBES · 965 TESTS 🎉)
Timing Disclosure: 0ms reported at nominal 1ms display resolution; actual duration unresolved/not_measured; no sub-1ms upper bound established
Synthetic in-memory policy evaluation in enterprise-guardrails.ts; live SBC B2BUA RFC 3323 header and SDP rewrite latency is not_measured.
✅ P1039: clampedCleartextForwardsDespiteCriticalPrivacy = 0, tokens in [1, 6] | ✅ P1040 🎉: leakedFields = 0, unstrippedPrivacyHeaders = 0
